description: List the most recently published issues of the Journal officiel de la République française, each with its id, publication date, JO number and the texts it contains. A text id inside an issue can be read with fr_legifrance_text.

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own PISTE OAuth2 credentials as "client_id:client_secret" (application subscribed to the "Légifrance Beta" API product); Pipeworx supplies one if omitted.

n.description: Number of recent issues to return, 1-30 (default 5).

name: fr_legifrance_journal_officiel_recent
title: Fr Legifrance Journal Officiel Recent
